item.title: Write a Programme Note for Two Short Performances
item.prompt_text: Two short performances share a programme. One uses movement and a single metal chair to tell a story without spoken words. The other uses a live reader and recorded street sounds. Write a programme note that helps visitors attend to each piece without giving away its ending, gives one connection between them, and tells audiences when to stay seated.
item.audience: first-time visitors to a local performance night
item.target_grammar: Relative clauses, contrast and precise future forms for programme instructions.
item.target_structure: Introduce each piece, give an observation to listen or look for, then state the practical instruction.

checklist.point: Give spectators a cue for the movement piece.
Give a separate cue for the sound piece.
Name a specific link between the two.
Explain when the audience should stay seated.
